subject: Latency incident — compensation & trial top-up
messages:
From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@horizonretail.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: suresh@horizonretail.com
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:17:12 -0800
Subject: Major latency spikes during Black Friday integration test window

Jonas —

We had a scheduled integration test from 03:30–04:15 PST this morning and observed multiple 2–10s tail latencies on generation requests across our main checkout flow. This caused several test transactions to time out and blocked our QA from validating the holiday promo handling. I attached a short incident_summary and a few logs.

We need to understand (1) what happened, (2) whether this impacts our production cutover next week, and (3) what remediation/compensation Redwood can offer given this is part of the paid POC phase. Horizon is evaluating a multi-year commitment and this timing is... not ideal.

Appreciate a quick confirmation you received this and an ETA for next steps.

—Alex
Director, Platform Engineering
Horizon Retail

Attachments: incident_summary_20261208.pdf (report), sla_snapshot_20261208.png (request latency graph)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@horizonretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 10:02:45 -08:00
Subject: Re: Major latency spikes during Black Friday integration test window

Alex — thanks for flagging and for the detailed artifacts. I’m escalating this immediately to our SRE/engine team (looping Rishi) and to our CS lead Marissa so we can triage and provide concrete next steps.

Immediate asks from our side:
- Rishi: can we get a first-pass root cause and whether this was an autoscaler/backpressure/overflow event?
- Marissa: I’ll coordinate compensation/POC makegood options and proposed trial top-ups while we investigate.

I’ll follow up within 2 hours with an interim update and share an internal timeline for a full RCA. Apologies for the disruption — we know how critical this window is for you.

—Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0172

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 11:58:09 -08:00
Subject: Re: Major latency spikes during Black Friday integration test window

On Tue, Dec 8, 2026 at 11:58 AM Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex — thanks for flagging and for the detailed artifacts. I’m escalating this immediately to our SRE/engine team (looping Rishi) and to our CS lead Marissa so we can triage and provide concrete next steps.

We pulled the traces and token-level metrics. Preliminary notes:
- There was a short-lived spike in queueing on one of the shard pools in us-west-2 between 03:33–03:41 PST.
- Root cause appears to be a mis-applied kernel selection heuristic for a new model variant that increased syscall-backed memory pressure under a specific sequence-length distribution. This caused CPU throttling on a minority of hosts until the autoscaler replaced the unhealthy instances.
- Impact: ~9% of requests in that window experienced tail latencies >3s, ~1% above 5s. No data exfiltration or request loss observed.

Next steps we’re taking now:
1) Roll back the heuristic on the affected pools (in progress — ETA 30m)
2) Increase short-term overprovisioning for your reserved pool for Wednesday ramp (done)
3) A postmortem with mitigation checklist — will share within 48 hours

I’ll send a short technical note for your engineers to explain the cause. From a service-level perspective this is a regression against our latency SLO for Premium Dedicated tiers.

—Rishi
Senior Staff Engineer, Runtime

Attachments: proposed_remedy_template.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 12:42:33 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Remedy proposal for Horizon — credit + trial top-up

Jonas / Rishi — thanks for the quick triage. Proposed customer-facing remedy (draft):
- Goodwill: 25% credit against November POC invoices prorated for affected request volume.
- Trial top-up: 100k free-generation token credit added to Horizon’s account, valid 90 days, to offset testing gaps during this critical ramp.
- SLA addon: one-time SLA exception for this POC cutover window (internal note: track for billing).

Rationale: Horizon is high-touch, evaluating enterprise rollout. We should balance remediation generosity with precedent; this matches similar situations we offered Q4 last year. If legal/finance needs signoff we can loop them but recommend we offer this within 24 hours to preserve momentum.

Jonas — if you get Alex offline, propose the package and mark in HubSpot. I’ll prepare a DocuSign-friendly credit memo.

—Marissa
Director, Customer Success

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Major latency spikes during Black Friday integration test window

Alex — quick update: Rishi’s team isolated the cause and applied an immediate rollback; we’ve increased overprovisioning for your reserved pool to prevent recurrence during your planned cutover.

To make up for the disruption we’d like to offer the following package immediately:
- 25% credit on your November POC invoices (prorated to affected request volume)
- 100k free-generation token credit, valid 90 days, added to your account today
- One-time SLA exception recorded for the POC cutover window

If that works we’ll push the credits and I'll send a short credit memo (DocuSign) for internal audit. Would you like the token credit applied to a test sub-account or the main account?

Best,
—Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
